verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents the Relay Proxy, a small Go application that runs on your own infrastructure, and a community report notes it is open source. That lets flag data be cached and served locally, which partly keeps evaluation traffic in-house. The evidence describes LaunchDarkly as a SaaS service, though, and nothing shows the full platform (UI, management, targeting, analytics) being self-hostable or distributed as open source. Missing for 10: a self-hostable full platform/control plane, an open-source distribution of the core platform, and documentation of fully on-premises data residency.
